name: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc.
summary: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc. manufactures, markets, and sells organic and natural products in the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and internationally. The company offers infant formula; infant and toddler formula, infant cereals, baby food pouches, snacks and frozen toddler and kids' foods; plant-based beverages such as soy, rice, oat, cashew and spelt; and condiments, as well as meat-free dishes and meals. It also provides cooking and culinary oils, vinegars; nutritional oils and supplements; broth and soups; yogurts; desserts and creamers; and nut butters.
